name: Tunnel gallery
purpose: A 45 m curving, low timber-floored tunnel that slows guests down before the hush zone: lanterns thin out, the air warms and the orange glow of the chamber grows ahead.

ceiling_profile.note: Lava tube, 3.5 m at the crown and lower at the walls. The last 6 m before the chamber neck down to 4.0 x 3.0 m (see anchored neck_frame).

hero.why: The orange glow of the magma glass seen through the chamber mouth from the bend at (52, 46): the tunnel is aimed at it for its last 12 m and nothing else is that bright. Placed by b4_chamber.

anchored.why: Timber frame narrowing the tunnel to 4 x 3 m just before the chamber: the compressed threshold before the biggest reveal on B4.
One bench in the outside of the bend, where the glow first appears.

sightlines.see: The tunnel curving away left, lantern pools on both walls, faint orange beyond the curve.
Straight down the last leg through the neck frame to the chamber filled with orange light.
Amber lantern line back to the lobby.

concept.match: Plan-only concept: curving hinoki walkway between close black rock, lanterns on both walls at regular pools, the turn ahead hinting at orange.

lights.why: Staggered wall niches on the first leg and the first bend (no mirrored pairs), with gaps lengthening toward the bend.
Two low niches on the last leg only; the chamber glow leads.
One warm pool about 6 m in, on the axis of the lobby's lift-door view (review b4_lobby).
Three hanging lantern pools on the first leg and first bend, staggered; the niches alone left the tunnel black (r1 render).

dressing.why: Low rough basalt along the wall base; wall niches are cut into it. The floor is a hinoki walkway (floor finish, not a proxy).

mood.key: orange glow at the end of a curving tunnel
mood.mist: None; a faint heat shimmer near the chamber.

waivers.reason: Borrowed view of the chamber's glass wall.

The glass wall (b4_chamber:hero) is round two bends from the lobby end; the entry camera sees the first bend and the warm pool, and the reveal at the second bend frames the glow. Visibility from the entry is 0 by design.

spine_note: Spine smoothed (Chaikin x3) inside the 5 m band; walls stay as the layout band until the lead fillets it (see report).
